text: They cut my hours without telling me. I found out from the rota. I'm furious.
They cut my hours. I'll struggle with rent now. I feel low and scared.
My brother lied to Mum about where the money went. How dare he.
My brother and I haven't spoken in a year. I miss him. It just hurts.
Someone dented my car and drove off. No note. I'm livid.
Sold Dad's old car today. Watched it go and felt hollow.
The council ignored our complaint for the fourth time. I wrote them a very angry letter.
The council knocked down the old library. I spent my childhood there. Feels like losing a friend.
Boss blamed me for his mistake in front of the client. I wanted to throw my laptop.
Boss said my work 'isn't good enough' and I went home and cried. I'm so disappointed in myself.
The app crashed again and lost my notes. Third time. So irritating.
Lost the notebook with all of Gran's recipes. Can't replace it. Heartbroken.
Stuck in traffic for two hours because of roadworks nobody's working on. Grr.
Stuck in traffic and the radio played our wedding song. Cried at the lights. Miss her.
Can't get the code to compile. Tried everything. Banging my head on the desk.
Didn't get the job. They went with someone else. Feeling flat and rejected.
The kids won't listen. I've asked ten times to put shoes on. My patience is gone.
The kids are at their dad's for the holidays. The house is so quiet. I miss them.
Someone stole my parcel off the doorstep. Again. Absolutely fuming.
The parcel was a gift from Nana, the last one she sent. Now it's gone. I just feel empty.
He laughed at me in front of everyone. I'm boiling with rage.
He moved out today. I sat on the bed for an hour, just quiet and sad.
Printer jammed right before the meeting. Ugh. Of course.
Meeting confirmed what we feared. The project's cancelled and people will lose their jobs. Heavy heart.
Settled evening. Dinner done, book open, nothing I'd change.
Brilliant evening. Surprise visit from Sol, we laughed until midnight.
My life is pretty much how I want it right now. Steady job, good friends, a quiet flat.
Got the keys to the flat today! Jumped around the empty living room.
Satisfied with the week. Did what I planned, nothing more, nothing less.
What a week! Won the quiz, saw old friends, the sun shone every day.
Thank you, Ruth, for sitting with me at the hospital all night. I won't forget it.
Ruth and I went to the funfair and screamed on every ride. Best day.
Grateful for my neighbours. They shovelled our path and brought soup when we were ill.
Street party with the neighbours. Music, food, kids running around. Loved it.
So thankful Dad's surgery went well. Thank you to every nurse on that ward.
Dad's home and we had a big dinner to celebrate. Laughter round the table again.
Nothing exciting, just a comfortable Sunday at home. That's enough for me.
Sunday trip to the zoo. The penguins! The kids were thrilled and so was I.
I appreciate how my partner always makes my coffee before I'm awake. Lucky.
Partner booked a surprise weekend away! Giddy all evening.
Oh brilliant, another rejection email. Exactly what I needed today.
Wonderful. The boiler's broken in January. My favourite kind of adventure.
Thrilled that my 'friend' told everyone my secret. Such loyalty.
Love spending my Saturday on hold to the bank. Best hobby ever.
Great, the dog ate my glasses. Can't wait to explain that at work.
Fantastic, the train's cancelled again. Really loving this commute.
So glad my manager scheduled a 7am call on my day off. Truly considerate.
Lovely of my sister to announce my break-up at the family dinner. Very kind.
Yay, a fourth night of the neighbours' party. Sleep is overrated anyway.
Excellent, I locked myself out in the rain. Nailed it.
Super, the landlord's 'fix' made the leak worse. Top-class work.
Awesome, nobody remembered my birthday. Such a special day.
Perfect, spilled coffee on my white shirt right before the interview. Of course.
Wonderful, another 'urgent' task dumped on me at 5pm. Living the dream.
Love how the airline lost my bag and then hung up on me. Fabulous service.
Great timing, the car died on the motorway in the dark. Brilliant.
Fantastic, my ex is dating my best friend. What a lovely surprise.
Yay, another family holiday where Dad criticises everything. Can't wait.
Brilliant, my 'quick' dentist visit turned into two fillings and a bill I can't afford. Love it.
So nice to be the only one who wasn't invited to the team drinks. Really makes you feel welcome.
Wonderful start to the year: laid off on January the 2nd. Thanks, universe.
Excellent, the 'five-minute' form took two hours. Government websites are a joy.
Great, my flatmate ate my labelled leftovers. Again. Very respectful.
Lovely, it's raining on the one day I planned a picnic. Just my luck.
Perfect, the dog was sick on the new carpet. Best gift ever.
Amazing, I get to work this bank holiday too. Truly blessed.
Wonderful, the school wants a cake for tomorrow. At 9pm. I love baking at midnight.
Oh good, the scale says I gained four pounds on holiday. Fabulous.
Fantastic, they've cancelled the only bus to my village. Who needs to get to work.
Brilliant, my phone screen cracked the day after the warranty ended. Lucky me.
So grateful to my colleague for taking full credit for my idea in the meeting. What a gem.
Thanks, autocorrect, for sending 'I love you' to my boss instead of my wife. Smooth.
Proud moment: I burnt the pasta. Pasta. Michelin, here I come.
Wonderful, the hospital moved Mum's surgery again. Third time. Very reassuring.
Great news, my rent's going up again and the mould's still there. Value for money.
Lovely, ate dinner alone on Valentine's Day. Romance is alive.
Excellent, I forgot my own anniversary. Husband of the year.
Fantastic, it took three doctors to say 'it's probably stress'. So helpful.
Super, the gym membership renewed itself for another year I won't use. Thanks.
Amazing, my 'quick' coffee with Jade turned into four hours of her complaining about her ex. Riveting.
